{{Quote|After last month's spectacular explosion of the South Quarter Mining Refinery, Queen Talia hasn't made a single appearance.|A news broadcast on Onderon|<ref name="TSL" />}}
The '''South Quarter Mining Refinery''' was a [[Mining/Legends|refinery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. In the [[Standard month/Legends|month]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Onderon Civil War]]<ref name="TSL" /> in [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the refinery exploded. Onderon's [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]], did not make any public appearances for some time after the incident which, royal officials claimed, was one of three recent assassination attempts against her. News reports later warned of the escape of [[Unidentified Human journalist (Onderon)|one of]] the suspected saboteurs, an [[Iziz Comm]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]].<ref name="TSL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The refinery was mentioned in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' during a news broadcast the player can listen to on Onderon.<ref name="TSL" />
